header: Put one till on Aichbrunn Kasse and look at the month it produces
subheader: Thirty days, no card, and your present till keeps running beside it.
lead: Most bakeries start with the branch that gives them the most trouble at cashing-up time. If it does not help there it will not help anywhere, and an afternoon is the only thing you have spent.
note: € 39 per till and month afterwards, cancellable to the end of any month.
